description: An offline AI-powered desk companion robot unit that translates natural language commands using a local LLM into motor movements and eye/face animations on an ESP32 via WebSockets, with dedicated AP-mode UDP camera streaming from an ESP32-CAM.

chat.engine.py: ChatEngine class managing Ollama LLM conversation history and querying.
chat.prompts.py: System prompt, identity, emotion rules, and movement tool instructions.
chat.parser.py: Extracts [emotion] tags and parses tool calls from LLM JSON responses.

vision.receiver.py: VisionReceiver class handling AP discovery handshake (port 2223) and reassembling 22-byte header UDP packets into frames (port 2222).
vision.frame_buffer.py: Thread-safe latest-frame buffer with zero queue buildup.
vision.vlm.py: VLMClient for on-demand visual reasoning with Qwen3-VL/LLaVA.

audio.engine.py: SonicEmotionEngine for R2-D2 Astromech prosody/WAV synthesis and SonicClient for TCP communication with ESP32-CAM Head Unit (192.168.4.1:5000).

robot.controller.py: RobotController WebSocket client managing connection to ws://{ip}:81, motor/OLED commands, and integrated SonicClient for synchronized R2-D2 droid vocalizations.
robot.protocol.py: Command strings, constants, and scroll timing calculations for OLED speech box.

packages.main.py: Main CLI loop integrating ChatEngine, RobotController (with SonicClient), and VisionReceiver.

controller.purpose: ESP32 Body & OLED firmware managing WebSocket server, DRV8833 dual motors, and speech scrolling.

head.purpose: ESP32-CAM Head Unit ('IKRU-CAM' / 192.168.4.1) firmware streaming UDP video on port 2222 with discovery on port 2223, and driving SmartElex speaker R2-D2 glissando sweeps on GPIO 2 via TCP on port 5000.

eyes-demo.purpose: Standalone U8g2 dynamic eye animations demo.

vision.esp32_cam_ap: Standalone AP mode firmware (IKRU-CAM / 192.168.4.1) streaming chunked UDP JPEGs on port 2222 with discovery on port 2223.
vision.test_udp_receiver.py: Standalone UDP test receiver with MobileNet-SSD object detection.

speaker.esp32_cam_speaker: Standalone speaker diagnostic sketch testing GPIO 2 tone and melody generation on ESP32-CAM.
speaker.speak_test.py: WAV audio converter and streaming client.

audio.sonic_emotion.py: R2-D2 Astromech SonicEmotionEngine class converting robot emotions, intents, and natural language sentences into authentic frequency sweeps (chirps), syllable-cadence beeps, warbles/trills, and staccato droid chatter with continuous-phase WAV synthesizer.
audio.test_sonic_emotion.py: Automated unit tests covering all 18+ R2-D2 droid vocalizations, glissando sweeps, intensity levels, intent blending, sentence prosody, and ESP32 command serialization.
audio.interactive_test.py: Interactive CLI test harness supporting arbitrary natural sentence replication into R2-D2 vocalizations, word-length driven durations, ASCII sweep ladders, PC audio preview, and direct WebSocket transmission to ESP32 AP (ws://192.168.4.1:81).
audio.esp32_sonic_speaker: Standalone non-blocking ESP32 firmware sketch broadcasting 'IKRU-AUDIO' AP at 192.168.4.1, generating continuous-sweep glissando hardware PWM audio on SmartElex speaker via serial, WebSocket, or TCP.
